catalogScope: Representative catalog of 57 manufacturer-listed models across multiple brands, chemistries and formats. It does not cover every global SKU, establish availability or recommend a cell. Conditioned ratings and missing model data remain explicit.
modelContract: All OCV, DC resistance and temperature model fields are null unless separately qualified. Nominal voltage is not OCV. Loaded curves must not be relabelled as OCV. Temperature references require explicit adoption as scoped assumptions.

selectionRules: Selecting an identity must not silently provide synthetic OCV or DC resistance.
A null rating or condition means unknown, not zero.
Nominal voltage must never substitute for an OCV-SOC curve.
Changing brand or chemistry must clear previous model assumptions.
Temperature references require explicit adoption and a visible scope/uncertainty label.
Do not extrapolate temperature references or interpret capacity factors as irreversible charge loss.
